Braille Translator

Translate text into Unicode braille patterns (Grade 1), including capitals and numbers with the number sign.

Grade 1 · ⠠ = capital follows · ⠼ = number follows (a–j = 1–0).

📖 How to use

  1. Enter text or braille characters.
  2. Choose Encode or Decode.
  3. Press Run.
  4. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is Grade 1 braille?

Grade 1 braille maps each letter to a dot pattern: a=⠁, b=⠃, c=⠉ and so on, rendered as Unicode braille characters.

How are numbers shown?

The number sign ⠼ comes first, then digits use the letters a–j (⠼⠁ = 1, ⠼⠚ = 0).

Can it decode braille back?

Yes — decode braille patterns back to letters, capitals and digits.
